matches.text: NIST’s **September 2005 NCSTAR 1-1J**, printed page 27 / PDF page 61, section 6.3, already described removal of existing sprinkler piping and heads from the seventh-floor OEM generator room, along with the first-floor fuel-tank room’s fire-suppression arrangements (including the Inergen system and related fire-protection details). A newly posted record mentioning those features would not, by itself, reveal a previously unknown fact—although the underlying source document might be newly accessible.
